content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: No amount is printed. Salary will be as per ICMR rules; salary and other allowances will be as per AIIMS/ICMR/GOI guidelines. Temporary and contractual position up to 31st March 2027, extendable based on requirements and funding. Performance reviewed every 30 days. Notice period of 15 days required for resignation or deposit the salary.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 17 vacancies: 8 Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) (Social Scientist, for outstation fieldwork), 1 Project Research Scientist-I Project Manager / Coordinator (Non-Medical, for outstation fieldwork), 8 Project Technical Support-III (Social Science- for outstation fieldwork) Field coordination support staff.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) (Social Scientist, for outstation fieldwork): maximum 45 years; Project Research Scientist-I Project Manager / Coordinator (Non-Medical, for outstation fieldwork): maximum 35 years; Project Technical Support-III (Social Science- for outstation fieldwork) Field coordination support staff: maximum 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As per ICMR rules for Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) (Social Scientist, for outstation fieldwork), As per ICMR rules for Project Research Scientist-I Project Manager / Coordinator (Non-Medical, for outstation fieldwork), As per ICMR rules for Project Technical Support-III (Social Science- for outstation fieldwork) Field coordination support staff.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate Degree in relevant discipline with required post qualification experience or PhD. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Extensive travel across different states of India is required for house-to-house based surveys. No arrangement for returning to Delhi between field visits. Full-time availability is mandatory during active fieldwork. Private practice, tuition, coaching, or online classes are strictly banned during employment.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates not having essential qualifications; their applications shall be cancelled automatically. Only candidates who can join immediately need to apply.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Preparation of merit list based on percentage marks in essential qualifications and desirable qualifications. Shortlisting of candidates in 1:5 ratio per post. Written test/exercises on computer/clinical examination (optional by committee). Personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary and contractual position up to 31st March 2027, extendable based on requirements and funding. Performance reviewed every 30 days. Notice period of 15 days required for resignation or deposit the salary.
